054/**
055 * Provides methods to load a constraint set expressed in XML.
056 * <p>
057 * Loaded constraint instances are cached to avoid the need to load them for
058 * every use. Any constraint set imported is also loaded and cached
059 * automatically.
060 */
061@SuppressWarnings("PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects")
062public class XmlConstraintLoader
063    extends AbstractLoader<List<IConstraintSet>>
064    implements IConstraintLoader {
065
066  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.UseConcurrentHashMap")
067  @NonNull
068  private static final Map<IEnhancedQName,
069      Handler<Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>>>> SCOPE_OBJECT_MAPPING = ObjectUtils.notNull(
070          Map.ofEntries(
071              Map.entry(XmlModuleConstants.ASSEMBLY_QNAME, XmlConstraintLoader::handleScopedAssembly),
072              Map.entry(XmlModuleConstants.FIELD_QNAME, XmlConstraintLoader::handleScopedField),
073              Map.entry(XmlModuleConstants.FLAG_QNAME, XmlConstraintLoader::handleScopedFlag)));
074
075  @NonNull
076  private static final XmlObjectParser<Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>>> SCOPE_PARSER
077      = new XmlObjectParser<>(SCOPE_OBJECT_MAPPING) {
078
079        @SuppressWarnings("synthetic-access")
080        @Override
081        protected Handler<Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>>> identifyHandler(XmlCursor cursor, XmlObject obj) {
082          Handler<Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>>> retval;
083          if (obj instanceof Scope.Assembly) {
084            retval = XmlConstraintLoader::handleScopedAssembly;
085          } else if (obj instanceof Scope.Field) {
086            retval = XmlConstraintLoader::handleScopedField;
087          } else if (obj instanceof Scope.Flag) {
088            retval = XmlConstraintLoader::handleScopedFlag;
089          } else {
090            throw new IllegalStateException(String.format("Unhandled element type '%s'.", obj.getClass().getName()));
091          }
092          return retval;
093        }
094
095      };
096
097  @Override
098  protected List<IConstraintSet> parseResource(@NonNull URI resource, @NonNull Deque<URI> visitedResources)
099      throws IOException {
100
101    // parse this metaschema
102    METASCHEMACONSTRAINTSDocument xmlObject = parseConstraintSet(resource);
103
104    // now check if this constraint set imports other constraint sets
105    int size = xmlObject.getMETASCHEMACONSTRAINTS().sizeOfImportArray();
106    Set<IConstraintSet> importedConstraints;
107    if (size == 0) {
108      importedConstraints = CollectionUtil.emptySet();
109    } else {
110      try {
111        importedConstraints = new LinkedHashSet<>();
112        for (METASCHEMACONSTRAINTSDocument.METASCHEMACONSTRAINTS.Import imported : xmlObject.getMETASCHEMACONSTRAINTS()
113            .getImportList()) {
114          URI importedResource = URI.create(imported.getHref());
115          importedResource = ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.resolve(importedResource));
116          importedConstraints.addAll(loadInternal(importedResource, visitedResources));
117        }
118      } catch (MetaschemaException ex) {
119        throw new IOException(ex);
120      }
121    }
122
123    // now create this constraint set
124    return CollectionUtil.singletonList(new ScopedConstraintSet(
125        ISource.externalSource(resource),
126        parseScopedConstraints(xmlObject, resource),
127        importedConstraints));
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Parse the provided XML resource as a Metaschema constraints.
132   *
133   * @param resource
134   *          the resource to parse
135   * @return the XMLBeans representation of the Metaschema contraints
136   * @throws IOException
137   *           if a parsing error occurred
138   */
139  @NonNull
140  private static METASCHEMACONSTRAINTSDocument parseConstraintSet(@NonNull URI resource) throws IOException {
141    try {
142      XmlOptions options = new XmlOptions();
143      options.setBaseURI(resource);
144      options.setLoadLineNumbers();
145      return ObjectUtils.notNull(METASCHEMACONSTRAINTSDocument.Factory.parse(resource.toURL(), options));
146    } catch (XmlException ex) {
147      throw new IOException(ex);
148    }
149  }
150
151  /**
152   * Parse individual constraint definitions from the provided XMLBeans object.
153   *
154   * @param xmlObject
155   *          the XMLBeans object
156   * @param resource
157   *          the resource containing the constraint content
158   * @return the scoped constraint definitions
159   */
160  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidInstantiatingObjectsInLoops") // intentional
161  @NonNull
162  protected List<IScopedContraints> parseScopedConstraints(
163      @NonNull METASCHEMACONSTRAINTSDocument xmlObject,
164      @NonNull URI resource) {
165    List<IScopedContraints> scopedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
166
167    StaticContext.Builder builder = StaticContext.builder()
168        .baseUri(resource);
169
170    METASCHEMACONSTRAINTSDocument.METASCHEMACONSTRAINTS constraints = xmlObject.getMETASCHEMACONSTRAINTS();
171
172    constraints.getNamespaceBindingList().stream()
173        .forEach(binding -> builder.namespace(
174            ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getPrefix()), ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getUri())));
175
176    builder.useWildcardWhenNamespaceNotDefaulted(true);
177
178    ISource source = ISource.externalSource(builder.build(), false);
179
180    for (Scope scope : constraints.getScopeList()) {
181      assert scope != null;
182
183      List<ITargetedConstraints> targetedConstraints = new LinkedList<>(); // NOPMD - intentional
184      try {
185        SCOPE_PARSER.parse(source, scope, Pair.of(source, targetedConstraints));
186      } catch (MetapathException | XmlValueNotSupportedException ex) {
187        if (ex.getCause() instanceof MetapathException) {
188          throw new MetapathException(
189              String.format("Unable to compile a Metapath in '%s'. %s",
190                  source.getSource(),
191                  ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
192              ex);
193        }
194        throw ex;
195      }
196
197      URI namespace = ObjectUtils.notNull(URI.create(scope.getMetaschemaNamespace()));
198      String shortName = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(scope.getMetaschemaShortName());
199
200      scopedConstraints.add(new DefaultScopedContraints(
201          namespace,
202          shortName,
203          CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(targetedConstraints)));
204    }
205    return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(scopedConstraints);
206  }
207
208  private static void handleScopedAssembly(
209      @NonNull ISource source,
210      @NonNull XmlObject obj,
211      Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>> state) {
212    Scope.Assembly assembly = (Scope.Assembly) obj;
213
214    IModelConstrained constraints = new AssemblyConstraintSet(source);
215    ConstraintXmlSupport.parse(constraints, assembly, ObjectUtils.notNull(state.getLeft()));
216
217    state.getRight().add(new AssemblyTargetedConstraints(
218        source,
219        () -> CollectionUtil.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
220            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(assembly.getTarget()),
221            source.getStaticContext())),
222        constraints));
223  }
224
225  private static void handleScopedField( // NOPMD false positive
226      @NonNull ISource source,
227      @NonNull XmlObject obj,
228      Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>> state) {
229    Scope.Field field = (Scope.Field) obj;
230
231    IValueConstrained constraints = new ValueConstraintSet(source);
232    ConstraintXmlSupport.parse(constraints, field, ObjectUtils.notNull(state.getLeft()));
233
234    state.getRight().add(new FieldTargetedConstraints(
235        source,
236        () -> CollectionUtil.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
237            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(field.getTarget()),
238            source.getStaticContext())),
239        constraints));
240  }
241
242  private static void handleScopedFlag( // NOPMD false positive
243      @NonNull ISource source,
244      @NonNull XmlObject obj,
245      Pair<ISource, List<ITargetedConstraints>> state) {
246    Scope.Flag flag = (Scope.Flag) obj;
247
248    IValueConstrained constraints = new ValueConstraintSet(source);
249    ConstraintXmlSupport.parse(constraints, flag, ObjectUtils.notNull(state.getLeft()));
250
251    state.getRight().add(new FlagTargetedConstraints(
252        source,
253        () -> CollectionUtil.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
254            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(flag.getTarget()),
255            source.getStaticContext())),
256        constraints));
257  }
258}
